lead.description: a rank test of whether several samples could come from the same continuous distribution

nist_kruskal2002.title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, §7.4.1: The Kruskal-Wallis test
nist_kruskal2002.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

overview_sentence: The Kruskal-Wallis test compares several groups using ranks of the combined sample.

self_checks.title: Rank statistic
self_checks.prompt: Three groups of size 3 have rank sums 10, 15, and 20. What is H?

self_checks.title: A larger ranking
self_checks.prompt: Three groups of size 4 have rank sums 12, 24, and 48. What is H?

self_checks.title: Oil data threshold
self_checks.prompt: H is 13.64 and the chi-squared 5% reference with 3 degrees of freedom is 7.81. Does the test reject?
self_checks.answer: Yes. 13.64 is greater than 7.81, so the test rejects.
